meta.subject: History
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Higher Secondary Second Year History, Revised Edition 2025, English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.question_style: Maximum useful source-grounded bilingual competitive-exam coverage from Unit 1: socio-economic background, land tenures, de-industrialisation, famines, indentured labour, Western education, reform movements, racial discrimination and repressive laws, role of the press, Madras Native Association, Madras Mahajana Sabha, Indian National Congress, early nationalists, civil liberties, Naoroji and Drain Theory. Each examinable fact is reinforced through direct recall, association, recognition and statement-analysis formats.
meta.quality_policy: Grounded in the supplied 2025 English and Tamil textbooks. Classroom activities and low-value prompts are excluded. Four-option bilingual MCQs with explanations; generated statement questions use textbook-supported explanatory statements rather than invented negative trivia.
meta.page_reference_note: page_en refers to the printed English textbook page; Tamil page numbering differs and is not inferred.

I. நௌரோஜியின் முக்கிய நூல் India Wins Freedom.
II. புதிய நிலவருவாய் முறையின் ஒரு முக்கிய விளைவு எது — தனியார் பரிவர்த்தனைகளை ஒழித்தல்.
சரியான விடை எது?
opts_en: Both I and II are correct
I is correct; II is incorrect
I is incorrect; II is correct
Both I and II are incorrect
questions.exp_en: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
questions.exp_ta: கூற்று I மற்றும் II இரண்டும் தவறு.

questions.q_en:

II. நில ஏலங்களால் உருவான புதிய வர்க்கம் எது — கிராமக் கைவினைஞர்கள்.

questions.exp_ta: கூற்று I சரி; கூற்று II தவறு.
